_comment: Display config for Sri Lanka. Coherence-only (Level 1): no BTR / BER / NR7 data, so no btrMitigationSourceRef, countrySectors, or mitigationTaxonomy. Document taxonomy and provenance drive the dashboard with no code changes (same shape as panama-country-config.json).
name: Sri Lanka
_anchorDocTypeComment: Intentionally omitted. anchorDocType drives the Vision Anchor Coverage view, which treats one document as the country's north-star/long-term vision that every other doc operationalises (Mongolia: Vision 2050 = SECTORAL). Sri Lanka's three documents (NDC, NBSAP, LDN) are parallel convention commitments (climate / nature / land), not a vision-and-derivatives hierarchy, so no anchor is set and that view stays off.
_documentTypesComment: Sri Lanka's eight source documents. NDC/NBSAP/LDN from data_sri_lanka_15Jun26.xlsx: shortLabel / fullLabel verbatim from the xlsx Doc and Document columns, mediumLabel parenthetical = verbatim Convention column value. NAP/PPPP/NMP from data_sri_lanka_2Jul26.xlsx and NWRP/NFAP from pipeline extraction: fullLabel verbatim from the xlsx Document column / the document's own front matter, parenthetical = the sector domain. NMP objective is the policy's Vision (p.3) verbatim; NMP states no issuing author in its front matter (inquiries contact only), so author is omitted. Colors from the UNDP-compatible Tailwind palette; avoids reserved red (#dc2626 political sensitivity), BTR purple (#7c3aed), and OTHER grey (#78716c); mutually distinguishable.
_documentMetaComment: Reference metadata (docKind / published / author / url / objective) for the doc-focus panel; urls verified to return HTTP 200 on 2026-06-30 by reading each document's front matter. NDC 3.0 and LDN are direct PDFs (UNFCCC / UNCCD) and their objectives are near-verbatim from each document's cover letter. NBSAP: the Kunming-Montreal-aligned update is still in preparation and no public draft PDF was found, so no url / date / objective is set (the 2016-2022 NBSAP and the 2024 National Policy on Biodiversity are different documents and were not substituted).

_docProvenanceComment: Primary-source citations per document. The 15 Jun xlsx Source column was empty for every row, so citations name the document and country only; no URLs, dates, or other details are invented. NAP/PPPP/NWRP/NFAP details (titles, years, ministries) are verbatim from each document's own front matter or executive summary; fields that the documents do not state are omitted.
_targetProvenanceComment: Target curation provenance: NDC/NBSAP/LDN and NAP/PPPP rows are expert-curated (data_sri_lanka_15Jun26.xlsx, data_sri_lanka_2Jul26.xlsx). NWRP and NFAP rows were extracted by the document-extraction pipeline (python/src/extract.py, gpt-5.4) on 2026-07-02 and human-reviewed for provenance (one NWRP item removed because its claimed quote could not be located in the document). NFAP was additionally reviewed by a CO expert on 2026-07-02 (sri_lanka_NWRP_NFAP_for_review_2Jul26.xlsx): all 9 targets approved at target level, and 48 action lines she listed were added to activities (marked addedByReviewer, each verified verbatim against the document). NWRP remains pipeline evidence pending expert validation. NMP rows are expert-curated: the CO colleague extended data_sri_lanka_2Jul26.xlsx on 2 Jul 2026 17:03 (SharePoint version history) with NMP/NFAP/NWRP rows; the 55 NMP rows were ingested 2026-07-03 (ingest_sri_lanka_nmp_3jul26.py). The expert NFAP (118, clause-level) and NWRP (33) rows from that extension are NOT ingested pending the replace-vs-keep curation decision against the pipeline-extracted versions.
